title: Write an LRU cache
prompt: Implement the class LRUCache in src/lru.js: new LRUCache(capacity) with get(key) (undefined when missing), set(key, value), delete(key) and a size getter. get and set make the key the most recently used; when set would go over capacity, evict the least recently used key. capacity must be a positive integer, otherwise throw a RangeError.
